title: Veracity Bias and Beyond: Uncovering LLMs’ Hidden Beliefs in Problem-Solving Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring 'Attribution Bias' by prompting LLMs to assign correct and incorrect solutions to different racial groups (using direct labels like 'Black'/'Asian' or name proxies), measuring 'Evaluation Bias' by observing changes in model grading for identical solutions attributed to different racial identities, and evaluating stereotypical color assignments in generated visualization code.

Measuring 'Attribution Bias' by prompting LLMs to assign correct and incorrect solutions to male or female identities, and measuring 'Evaluation Bias' by observing inconsistencies in the model's evaluation and scoring of identical solutions when attributed to different genders.
